purpose: Typed payload for exact minimum or maximum duration Temporal Constraints. B04-E uses schedule.placement for planned Schedule duration; B08-C adds soft minimum session.active_duration for one Activity-owned Session, evaluated against active time only.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: MaterialStateRef of the Temporal Constraint rule revision owning this duration payload.
columns.value_contract: Exactly one duration payload row for every activated duration rule state.

columns.name: duration_kind_code
columns.meaning: Whether the exact planned Schedule placement duration is bounded from below or above.

columns.name: duration_microseconds
columns.meaning: Positive exact duration threshold for the selected constrained temporal facet.
columns.value_contract: Positive integer microseconds. schedule.placement means planned Schedule placement duration; session.active_duration means one Session’s active time after excluding captured pauses.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint_duration_state
primary_key.reason: At most one duration payload per Temporal Constraint rule MaterialState.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_duration_state_constraint_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: A duration payload cannot exist without the owning Temporal Constraint rule envelope.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_duration_state_kind
check_constraints.reason: The shared typed duration payload supports explicit minimum and maximum kinds; B08-C further narrows its admitted Session facet to minimum.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_duration_state_positive
check_constraints.reason: A duration threshold must be strictly positive.

indexes.name: pk_temporal_constraint_duration_state
indexes.reason: Duration payload lookup by rule MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_duration_state_rule_totality
triggers.reason: Require exactly one duration payload and enforce family/kind/facet/strength/subject totality: Schedule placement minimum/maximum, or direct Activity Session active-duration soft minimum only.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Immutable typed payload owned one-to-one by the Temporal Constraint rule MaterialState. Planned Schedule duration and active Session duration share the bounded duration payload without aliasing their facts.
state_history.current_binding: Currentness is inherited from the owning temporal_constraint_state through the shared scoped current binding.
state_history.chronology: No chronology is inferred from the duration value; current-history episodes remain authoritative.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime has SELECT-only read access after B04-E read activation; changed duration rules append a new MaterialState.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the owning historical rule MaterialState.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; retirement changes currentness rather than erasing typed historical payload.

obligations: duration kind is minimum or maximum
typed payload totality excludes simultaneous boundary/window payloads
runtime direct DML remains forbidden while SELECT supports canonical current-rule reads
automatic movement cannot bypass current hard duration rules
session.active_duration compares only one Session active duration and excludes paused intervals
separate Session identities are not aggregated
an open under-threshold Session is pending; an ended under-threshold Session is violated without blocking END
